sections.h2: What an online charging system does

blocks.text: Alepo Online Charging is an **online charging system** that charges every call, message and megabyte against the balance in real time. Bundles and brands change by configuration alone.

Prepaid-heavy operators and MVNEs must charge balances, bundles and several brands in real time, and the legacy charging suites they inherited are costly and slow to change. A modern OCS for telecom turns each change into a setting.

head: Fact
Detail
rows: The packet core and voice network over Diameter. Policy control for quotas. Vouchers, CRM and self-care for top-ups and balances.
In your environment, on Kubernetes, with 24x7 support

blocks.text: Also known as: OCS, real-time charging, **convergent charging**, prepaid charging, rating and balance management, Diameter Gy and Ro
Your marketing team changes bundles by configuration, without code, so a new offer does not wait for a release.
Balances, bundles and several brands are charged in real time.
Policy and BSS charging go through the charging gateway, so your current prepaid platform keeps running.
The packet core and the voice network connect over Diameter.
Vouchers, CRM and self-care connect for top-ups and balance checks. Policy control uses the same quotas.
It is built for MVNOs, MVNEs and prepaid-heavy operators.

items.q: What is an online charging system in telecom?
items.a: An **online charging system** checks and updates a subscriber's balance while the service is in use, so a call or data session is allowed only while credit or quota remains.
**Convergent charging** rates prepaid and postpaid usage for every service and brand on one system and one balance.

items.q: Can we keep our existing prepaid system?
items.a: Yes. The charging gateway lets an existing prepaid system stay while new bundles and brands run on Alepo.

blocks.text: Your team installs Online Charging in containers, one standard way, from the same automated guide as every Alepo product. Upgrades stay small.

When something needs fixing, the patch goes only to the component affected, with rollback ready, so your maintenance window stays short and nothing else has to be upgraded at the same time. Online Charging runs on Kubernetes in your environment, operated by your team or by Alepo, with 24x7 support from GTAC.
The build you test and see demoed is the build that goes live.
